tests.name: Source record complete
tests.bar: clip id, source id, interval, archive URL and reported rights present
tests.how: tools/validate.py reads the lot's source record.

tests.name: Reads as the category
tests.bar: above 0.75 (real human doodles)
tests.how: Quick, Draw! MobileViT classifier on the drawn keyframes (run before the head revision; in-betweens not yet scored)

tests.name: Looks hand-drawn
tests.bar: at least 30 percentile among real doodles of the category
tests.how: tools/style_score.py: simplify the drawing the way Quick, Draw! simplified its own data (scale to 255, RDP epsilon 2), then percentile of mean distance to 25 nearest real drawings of the category over six stroke statistics.

tests.name: Likeness to the chosen doodle
tests.bar: at least 0.5 (1 = the doodle's own stroke statistics)
tests.how: tools/gwp_tests.py: distance between the stroke statistics of each key and of the chosen doodle, in units of the category's spread, as exp(-RMS z).

tests.name: Keeps the doodle's identity
tests.bar: a fresh critic shown the doodle and the keys says bar met
tests.how: Critic packet from AGENTS.md; verdict file kept unedited in the lot.

tests.name: Background holds between keys
tests.bar: at least 90% of strokes stay put between keys on a locked-off shot
tests.how: tools/trace_keys.py: a stroke stays put if 90% of its points lie within 3 px of ink in every other key.

tests.name: Trace keeps the drawing
tests.bar: recall at least 0.98 and every ink piece kept
tests.how: tools/trace_keys.py: share of ink within line half-width + 2 px of a traced line; share of ink pieces of 20 px or more touched by a trace.

tests.name: Stroke count of a doodle
tests.bar: character strokes inside the 5th to 95th percentile of real doodles of the category
tests.how: Count traced character strokes; compare with Quick, Draw! stroke counts for the category.

tests.name: Strokes carry from key to key
tests.bar: at least 70% of ink matched between every pair of consecutive keys
tests.how: tools/match_strokes.py: keys aligned by translation, strokes matched by mean point distance (Hungarian); share of ink in kept matches, worst key pair.

tests.name: Holds the footage pose
tests.bar: mean at least 0.65, no frame below 0.45
tests.how: ink inside the SAM mask x bounding-box agreement; worst frame 15 at 0.48

tests.name: Planted feet stay put
tests.bar: under 2 px, measured on at least 4 planted intervals
tests.how: world-space drift of a hoof inside 6 planted key intervals (screen x minus camera pan)

tests.name: Body keeps its proportions
tests.bar: under 10% for each body segment
tests.how: coefficient of variation of neck, body and leg length across frames: neck 6.1%, body 6.8%, legs 9.8%

tests.name: Head travels on smooth arcs
tests.bar: under 4 px
tests.how: mean third difference of the nose position in world space; pops show up as spikes

tests.name: Every frame reads as the category
tests.bar: classifier p above 0.75 on every frame, not only keys
tests.how: Run the Quick, Draw! classifier on all in-between frames.

tests.name: Held lines do not boil
tests.bar: under 1 px frame-to-frame jitter on strokes meant to hold
tests.how: Match strokes across consecutive frames; measure mean point displacement on held parts.

tests.name: Contacts land when the footage lands
tests.bar: every foot plant within 1 frame of the plant in the footage
tests.how: Detect plants in SAM mask bottoms and in the cartoon's contacts; compare frame numbers.

tests.name: Character follows the subject
tests.bar: centroid path within 5% of frame width of the SAM centroid path
tests.how: Compare per-frame centroid of character ink with the SAM mask centroid.

tests.name: Near planes move faster
tests.bar: sky slowest, grass fastest
tests.how: screen speed per plane = camera pan x (reference depth / plane depth)

tests.name: Every drawing has a source
tests.bar: all
tests.how: each object records its Quick, Draw! key_id or that the agent drew it

tests.name: Exposure sheet covers the shot
tests.bar: every frame, keys marked
tests.how: x-sheet rows vs frames; K rows vs agent keys

tests.name: Nearer things hide farther ones
tests.bar: no far lines inside the walker body
tests.how: painted by construction; round 3 critic still saw young-giraffe lines between the front legs

tests.name: Page works on a phone
tests.bar: no sideways scroll, no script errors
tests.how: headless render at 390 and 1000 px wide

tests.name: Ledger chain intact
tests.bar: every ledger line hashes to the next
tests.how: loop.py verify over the lot's ledger.jsonl.

tests.name: Story reads with sound off
tests.bar: an independent viewer names the action and every animal
tests.how: 3 blind reviews; last open gap (young giraffes read as llamas) repaired, not yet re-reviewed

tests.name: Drawn beats traced
tests.bar: blind A/B preference for the drawn version
tests.how: blind critic with shuffled labels

tests.name: Keys alone tell it
tests.bar: keys-only playback reads as a walk
tests.how: next: play only the 9 keys to an independent critic

tests.name: A stranger would watch it twice
tests.bar: two of three fresh viewers choose to replay
tests.how: Show the shot at normal speed to three fresh critics; ask only whether they would watch it again and why.
